title: Injectivity of the localized punctured matching section map
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U its punctured spectrum, q:Y→U and s:E→Spec of its maximal-ideal completion finite morphisms, and D completion overlap data as in [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. For f in A with D(f) contained in U, let W be the inverse image of D(f) in the punctured restriction of Spec D.matchingRing, let ρ be the matching-ring restriction to Γ(W,O), and let ψ be pullback to the corresponding chart of Y under D.puncturedMap. For every b in D.matchingRing, ψ(ρ(b))=0 implies ρ(b)=0. This is vanishing of a numerator in the principal-open section ring, without an annihilating exponent.

source.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER, localized affine chart comparison.

proof.text: Apply the split-off left-inverse theorem for the punctured matching chart restriction. For any b whose image under ψ is zero, the left-inverse identity gives ρ b = 0 by rewriting g (ψ (ρ b)) using map_zero.

proof_origin.document: Internal reduction from the chart restriction left-inverse

lean.statement:
theorem puncturedMatching_chart_section_injective
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A) (hf :
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) ≤ U) :
    let W := (D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
    let ρ := ((ΓSpecIso D.matchingRing).inv ≫
      (W.ι ≫ (D.modelMap ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).appTop).hom
    let ψ := (D.puncturedMap ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    ∀ b : D.matchingRing, ψ (ρ b) = 0 → ρ b = 0
